maria: Kicking off a POC proof workbook for Helios. Need to align on integration steps, security asks, and pricing tiers. Goal: 2-week smoke + perf run.
maria: Doc link -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/helio-poc-workbook (workbook has tabs: checklist / integration / test-dataset / pricing / security)
devon: Got it — can you drop the network expectations? VPC peering vs shared peering, and do they need customer-managed KMS/HSM for this POC?
mar ia: (typo) meant @devon yes. They prefer customer-managed KMS but said they'll accept ephemeral keys for the initial smoke. I'll flag as a security exception if needed.
sam: Adding myself. On pricing — did we already send the two-tier POC quote (standard vs dedicated reserved burst)? I can resend if helpful. Also need to confirm if token pricing excludes egress.
tara: Security note: Helios requires SOC2 evidence and an ability to integrate with their KMS. For a POC we can do ephemeral keys, but customer-managed KMS will require a contract amendment + ~5 business days to enable.
devon: Integration runbook sketch:
```
1) Establish network (peering or VPN)
2) Exchange test credentials (short-lived)
3) Mount sample dataset (S3 link / anonymized)
4) Run smoke: 1k prompts, concurrency 8, capture latency + KV cache hit rate
5) Push results to workbook
```
devon: On the sample dataset — ask for a small "canary" of 100–500 rows that include edge cases. Prefer anonymized JSONL.
maria: Can someone confirm Helios IT point-of-contact so we can schedule peering? Sam — can you chase? Also propose POC start earliest Mon Apr 6.
ops-bot: created workspace infra-hel-1769998888 and provisioned ephemeral keys. Logs: https://infra.internal/redwood/infra-hel-1769998888
sam: Will ping their IT lead (cc: @Helios-IT) today. Also suggest we include eval metrics in the workbook: accuracy, hallucination count, median latency, p95 latency, tokens/cost per 1k.
tara: Agreed. Also add a security column: PII present? (Y/N), retention TTL, and whether KMS is customer-managed. Add checklist item: privacy sign-off from Helios legal.
maria: Ok next actions: @sam get IT contact + confirm peering type, @devon produce the integration runbook and a small terraform snippet for peering, @tara add the security checklist to the workbook, I'll update pricing tab and send a short pre-POC email to Helios with the workbook link.

sam: On it — I'll have IT contact and a confirmation email by EOD. :thumbsup:
